edit_summary: Substitute 920 proved zeros (93 FX bounds + 784 ordered same-sign zero-RHS row witnesses), delete 981 bound-certified rows, delete 60 aggregate rows by exact nonnegative row combinations, remove 22 continuous leaf definitions, merge 414 binary copies into 378 identity groups, substitute 14589 zero-cost monotone endpoints (14586 zeros, x31341=1, x31474=2, x33191=100000) and shift 309 retained RHS, then delete 417 further box rows; 15945 coordinates and 1480 rows removed, no new rows or variables.
claims: 4 claims = (forward, reverse) x (integers kept, integers relaxed); objective 'Equal' in all four, inverse null, and every claim carries the same 32793-pair projection of retained coordinates in output coordinate order.

Obligations per claim 150193 / 198753 / 118632 / 151980 = 619558 total; the integer-vs-relaxation gap in each direction is exactly the integrality obligations (31561 target integers forward, 46773 source integers reverse).
Steps per claim 10447 / 145 / 10447 / 145; peak live facts 10447, 493672 linear terms, 0 branches, 0 bijections, 0 points, all lift counters 0 (no case splits, no Menu/Flow/Interval rules).

Projection claim, not a bijection: 14589 zero-cost monotone auxiliaries are recovered at favorable endpoints, so the forward map is the identity on the 32793 retained coordinates while the reverse map recovers the other 15945 by 15517 constants, 406 alias singletons and 22 four-term leaf expressions.

agent_manual_work: Wrote two independent exact MPS readers (token split and fixed-field slices) and required them to agree on every row, coefficient, RHS, bound and integer marker; verify.py:11-75 repeats the fixed-field/token agreement on both artifacts.

Ordered the 784 zero witnesses so every premise zero precedes its use, and replayed support, coefficient sign, zero RHS and nonnegative lower bounds at each step; prepare_test54.py:62-72 rebuilds each witness as an EqPair of a scaled source row.

Hand-wrote the exact rational->fixed-field encoder (decimal_exact then mps_number) after a failing assertion on 13-character fields such as '0.00000100002'; the fix was dropping the leading zero of decimals to fit 12 columns.

Wrote output/verify.py (209 lines) that reparses both MPS files and replays every certificate by hand: box intervals (:77-85), box certificates (:86-151), zero/aggregate/leaf/identity/endpoint certificates, then the full matrix, RHS, domain and objective comparison.

Hand-built the four-mutation attack harness by deep-copying the certificate and poking JSON by shape (blocks[1].map constant -> -1, a Lin term pop, a checks pop, a reversed Lin term pop) at prepare_test54.py:191-197.
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_test54.py, 203 lines: exact(:16), fact(:20), box(:26), prepare(a,b,h)(:35), main(:179); imports parse_mps/row_ref, expression/plus/mul/expr_json/row_fact/sha, substitute and Builder.

fact() picks the cheapest witness: 'Exact' when the goal is reflexive and terminal, the single support Ref when len(terms)==1, coefficient 1, no constant and the same kind reproduce the goal, else emits builder.lin().
box() selects each term's bound side (VarUpper iff coefficient > 0 else VarLower), sums c*bound and refuses with the 'unbounded box' (:29) or 'box not valid' (:31) asserts.

exact/fact/box are the de-facto shared witness API: 25 sibling preparers import them (test9, test10, test11, test12, test13, test14, test15, test16, test17, test22, test24, test25, test30, test32, test35, test42, test43, test45, test50, test53, test62, test64, test69, test75, test76).

folded()(:97-119) rewrites row and objective expressions through the zeroeq, leafeq and aliaseq tables in that order, then through endpoint bound refs; prepare() consumes 7 audit tables and asserts the removed set equals the source-minus-target name diff (:42).
friction: 1 failing call: eval AssertionError 'largest encoded numeric width 13' on 0.00000100002-style decimals, i.e. the model writer had to control fixed-field width before any artifact existed.
No typed edit schema: the delivered target is bound to the claim only by audit.json's sha256, and 'target = source + these edits' rests on untrusted Python asserts (prepare_test54.py:42 and :146).
The same 32793-pair projection is restated in all four claims (1749728 B of the 1750180 B request.json) and the same step lists and maps twice (5161363 B of the 21115147 B RPA).

Helper failures are Python asserts rather than structured codes ('unbounded box' :29, 'box not valid' :31, 'missing identity path' :88, 'bad lin' prepare_test88.py:42), so a compiler layer cannot map them to diagnostics.
Bookkeeping dominates the reverse claims: 79900 of 198753 obligations are the literal string 'Exact' and 66489 are bound refs of coordinates that were just eliminated.
